question: Which of the following states/UTs has the first 100% fully digital literate Panchayat in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pullampara**** Panchayat** in Kerala is recognized as the first 100% fully digital literate Panchayat in India.
 
• Kerala has been a pioneer in achieving high literacy rates and digital literacy, making significant strides in education and technology.
 
• This achievement is a part of Kerala's broader initiatives to enhance digital literacy and e-governance across the state.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Kerala has consistently been at the forefront of literacy and digital initiatives in India.
 
• The state’s emphasis on education, healthcare, and social welfare has contributed to its high human development index.
 
• Kerala's model of development, often referred to as the "Kerala Model," focuses on equitable access to resources and services.
